findings.highlight: She should know that the Holy Grail is the only way to heal herself, but she doesn't even consider it as an option.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を得る事が体を治す一番の方法だと判っているだろうに、それを考えようとしていない。
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks Sakura should know obtaining Grail is best way of healing body.
findings.explanation: Best healing method becomes the only healing method.

findings.highlight: ...It's the only way I can repay Saber for going along with my selfishness.
findings.evidenceJa: ……それが俺の我が侭につき合い、命を落としたセイバーへの償いでもある。
findings.governingReading: Continuing the fight is also atonement toward Saber, whom Shirou understands to have died after going along with his selfishness.
findings.explanation: Shirou's stated atonement for Saber's death becomes repayment for her cooperation. 'Also' becomes 'the only way,' changing both the expressed cost of following him and his reason for continuing.

findings.highlight: "I-it doesn't bother me at all! Besides, Rider's eyes are Mystic Eyes. What if she hits you with her magecraft on impulse!?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「こ、困りませんっ！　だいたいですね、ライダーの目は魔眼なんですよ？　ちょっとした弾みで魔術にかかっちゃったらどうするんですか！」
findings.governingReading: Sakura warns that Shirou might inadvertently fall under the eyes' effect. Rider explains that even limiting her magical energy would not reliably exclude him.
findings.explanation: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.
